Summary: [Tầng 2][T1] LLM client abstraction + ZenMux GLM client
Description:
Định nghĩa IAssistantChatClient (provider-agnostic) + impl ZenMuxChatClient qua Microsoft.Extensions.AI, base_url https://zenmux.ai/api/v1, model z-ai/glm-5.2-free. ZenMuxOptions (BaseUrl, Model, ApiKey, TimeoutSeconds, MaxToolHops).
Acceptance: CompleteAsync trả text hoặc tool_call; ApiKey nạp từ ENV Assistant__ZenMux__ApiKey, fail-fast khi rỗng; retry/backoff cho 5xx/timeout/429.
Folder: src/FreshFlow.API/Assistant/Abstractions + Assistant/Llm. Deps: none. Ref: docs/TASKS-2026-06-22-ai-assistant-tier2-orchestration.md T1.

AssistantTool + AssistantToolRegistry.InvokeAsync(name,args,ctx) validate args, dựng record (inject UserId/MarketId), ISender.Send, map Result<T> về JSON. 5 MVP tool: search_products, create_draft_order, get_order, preview_confirmation, confirm_order.
Acceptance: LLM không điền được UserId/MarketId; Result.Failure -> {error,message}; loại field nhạy cảm (RemainingCreditAfter) khỏi payload gửi LLM.
Folder: Assistant/Tools. Deps: T1. Ref: TASKS T2.

IConversationStore + DbConversationStore (EF Core trên shared AppDbContext). Entity AssistantConversation (id, session_id unique, user_id, market_id?, state JSONB, created_at, updated_at, expires_at) + EF config trong FreshFlow.Infrastructure.Persistence; migration AddAssistantConversations. Lazy-expire khi đọc; hard-delete (không deleted_at).
Acceptance: round-trip qua Postgres; expires_at +30'/ghi; state lưu jsonb; migration apply sạch.
Deps: none. Note: Redis store = giai đoạn sau (drop-in). Ref: TASKS T3.

ConfirmationGate chặn confirm_order trừ khi request mang cờ tường minh confirmOrderId (từ nút UI) khớp orderId; thiếu cờ -> chạy preview_confirmation, trả pendingConfirmation thay vì confirm.
Acceptance: thiếu cờ -> KHÔNG gọi ConfirmOrderCommand; lệch cờ -> chặn; khớp -> cho qua. Test chứng minh ISender không nhận ConfirmOrderCommand khi bị chặn.
Folder: Assistant/Safety. Deps: T2. Ref: TASKS T4.

POST /api/v1/assistant/chat (auth JWT -> UserId; load state; append msg). Orchestrator loop: IAssistantChatClient -> tool_call (qua gate nếu confirm) -> registry -> append result -> lặp <= MaxToolHops -> text cuối. DTOs AssistantChatRequest(sessionId,message,marketId,confirmOrderId?) / AssistantChatResponse(reply,sessionId,pendingConfirmation?,draftOrderId?). System prompt tiếng Việt. AddAssistant(config) chain vào Program.cs. NON-STREAMING.
Acceptance: end-to-end search->draft->preview->confirm(cờ); MaxToolHops chặn loop; lỗi LLM -> reply lịch sự không lộ chi tiết.
Deps: T1-T4. Ref: TASKS T5.

Policy rate-limit 'assistant' (tái dùng pattern RateLimiting:Auth/Orders) gắn lên AssistantController. Section Assistant trong appsettings (ApiKey rỗng, nạp ENV). Validate config startup.
Acceptance: vượt PermitLimit/WindowMinutes -> 429; thiếu ApiKey lúc startup -> fail-fast.
Folder: Assistant/DependencyInjection.cs + Program.cs. Deps: T5. Ref: TASKS T6.
